description_en: Redeploys a specified instance either immediately or at a scheduled time
description_zh: 用于立即或预约重新部署指定资源的事件
kebab_example: aliyun ens event-redeploy-instance --event-id e-d71ff150945b9c02eb6ebc0016328468 --resource-id i-55qi8m11rr53c4i964md8a00l --ops-type immediate --plan-time 1742452232000 --plan-utc-time example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: EventRedeployInstance

parameters.help_en:
The O\&M task type. Valid values:

immediate: Immediate execution.

scheduled: Scheduled execution
parameters.help_zh:
运维任务类型，取值范围：

immediate：立即执行。
scheduled：预约执行
parameters.name: ops_type

parameters.help_en: The scheduled execution time, specified as a timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required if 'OpsType' is set to 'scheduled'
parameters.help_zh: 预约执行时间，时间戳，单位毫秒。 当OpsType=scheduled时，此字段为必输
parameters.name: plan_time
